svg.aria-label: FF02 C04 glass enclosure native CAD plan
svg.text: FF02 / Glass enclosure C04 / R06 planning proposal
Native FreeCAD unsectioned wireframe projection. Roof hidden for the plan.
Retained context: dark | Enclosure and fitout: brown | Grid: 1 ft
Masonry and curved balcony retained. Dashed green: 90-degree door pose and nominal latch arc.
Frame, glass, film, support and hardware sizes are provisional. Not fabrication or access approval.
Coplanar mesh seams suppressed in this drawing only. Native CAD geometry is unchanged.
